hints.title: Parity Bitmask
hints.text: Represent the even/odd parity of the five vowels (a, e, i, o, u) using a 5-bit integer state.

hints.title: Track Earliest Seen Index
hints.text: Record the earliest index at which each 5-bit mask state appears. An empty prefix before index 0 has state 0.

hints.title: Equal Prefix States Imply Even Differences
hints.text: If the mask at index i equals the mask at index j, all vowel counts between i + 1 and j must be even. Maximize j - i.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking every possible substring for vowel counts takes quadratic O(N^2) time, leading to time limit exceeded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since there are only 2^5 = 32 possible bitmask states, an array of size 32 provides O(1) state lookup.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies prefix parity masks and matches equal states to maximize interval length.
